overloads.semanticRole: The Get database parameter command allows you to get the current value of a 4D database parameter.

constraints: aTable is optional; if omitted, the parameter is retrieved/set for the default table.
When the selector's value is a character string, it is returned via stringValue instead of (or in addition to) the numeric function result.
_needsReview: selector accepts dozens of documented constants (each with its own scope/possible-values semantics, e.g. '4D Server timeout', 'Debug log recording', 'Direct2D status') that are not individually modeled here as an enum_ref -- the full table is very large and selector-specific behavior (e.g. some selectors are get-only) is left as prose in the doc, not encoded per-value.
